## What's new in 1.6.2

**A single canvas across all your monitors.** Thanks to @nextux, who contributed this one.

The Monitors setting has a third choice, **Single canvas across all monitors**: one module, one picture, spanning every monitor you have connected instead of a copy on each. One emulated PC draws for all of them, in the shape they make together, and each monitor shows its part, so a flying toaster crosses from one screen to the next. Start from desktop begins from a picture of all your monitors together, and when the module changes, it changes across them all.

Choose it in the settings window under Monitors, and **Preview** shows it full screen. It needs two or more monitors, and **A different module on each monitor** is off while it is chosen. **All monitors** and **Primary monitor only** work as they always have.
